figures.title: Freeze the sample rule before any outcome line
figures.desc: Write the sample rule first. Do not open an outcome line until that rule is on disk.
figures.caption: Write the sample rule before you open any outcome line.
figures.transcript: Write the sample rule first. Do not open an outcome line until that rule is on disk.

figures.title: Passes, failures, retries, dependents stay visible
figures.desc: Passes, failures, retries, and dependents stay in the eligible set. Hiding a row to make a tally close is a miss.
figures.caption: Keep passes, failures, retries, and dependents visible in the eligible set.
figures.transcript: Passes, failures, retries, and dependents stay in the eligible set. Hiding a row to make a tally close is a miss.

figures.title: One earliest failure per run
figures.desc: Open each run file. Write one earliest failure note. Do not tally until every run has that note.
figures.caption: Write one earliest failure note per run before any tally.
figures.transcript: Open each run file. Write one earliest failure note. Do not tally until every run has that note.

items.label: Find the earliest failure
items.detail: the first one in that run

items.label: Leave the note visible
items.detail: do not replace it with a tally

figures.title: Notes exist before tallies
figures.desc: The first-failure notes exist. Then tally categories. If the counts do not add up, record HOLD.
figures.caption: Tally categories only after the first-failure notes exist.
figures.transcript: The first-failure notes exist. Then tally categories. If the counts do not add up, record HOLD.

items.label: HOLD if they do not close

figures.title: Keep the original label next to the revision
figures.desc: If you revise a category, keep the original label visible next to the revision. The history is part of the record.
figures.caption: Keep the original label visible next to any revision.
figures.transcript: If you revise a category, keep the original label visible next to the revision. The history is part of the record.

figures.title: Counts close to the eligible set
figures.desc: PASS must sum. FAIL must sum. CATEGORY TOTAL must equal the eligible set. If a cell cannot close, record HOLD.
figures.caption: PASS and FAIL must each sum. CATEGORY TOTAL must equal the eligible set.
figures.transcript: PASS must sum. FAIL must sum. CATEGORY TOTAL must equal the eligible set. If a cell cannot close, record HOLD.

figures.title: Only a decidable defect becomes a predicate
figures.desc: A semantic judgment stays a note. Only a decidable defect becomes a predicate. Two literal strings under all_present are decidable by the supplied control.
figures.caption: Promote only a decidable defect to a predicate.
figures.transcript: A semantic judgment stays a note. Only a decidable defect becomes a predicate. Two literal strings under all_present are decidable by the supplied control.

figures.title: Input, pass, fail, missing
figures.desc: Exact input is one run file plus --config. Pass when at least one literal is absent. Fail when both literals are present as case-sensitive substrings. Missing path prints HOLD: missing input. Malformed config prints HOLD: malformed config.
figures.caption: Confirm input, pass, fail, and missing before you run the control.
figures.transcript: Exact input is one run file plus --config. Pass when at least one literal is absent. Fail when both literals are present as case-sensitive substrings. Missing path prints HOLD: missing input. Malformed config prints HOLD: malformed config.

items.label: Pass when at least one literal absent
Missing path prints HOLD: missing input

figures.title: Known bad fails, known good passes, missing HOLDs
figures.desc: The known-bad file fails. The known-good file passes. A missing path prints HOLD. Those three outcomes are the control.
figures.caption: Run known bad, known good, and missing. Read fail, pass, and HOLD.
figures.transcript: The known-bad file fails. The known-good file passes. A missing path prints HOLD. Those three outcomes are the control.
